index.md.notes: Excellent overview with clear installation instructions, environment variable documentation, and quick start examples. Strong coverage of monorepo structure and dual ESM/CJS build. Very good usability with practical examples.

architecture.md.notes: Comprehensive coverage of architectural patterns including the agent hierarchy, Symbol-based type guards, request processing pipeline, and design patterns. Excellent technical depth with accurate code references. Minor improvement needed in visual diagrams.

agents.md.notes: Thorough coverage of all agent types (LlmAgent, LoopAgent, ParallelAgent, SequentialAgent) with detailed configuration options, transfer mechanisms, and callbacks. Strong accuracy with verified code references. Could improve with more end-to-end examples.

tools.md.notes: Excellent coverage of FunctionTool, AgentTool, MCPToolset, and tool callbacks. Good documentation of ToolContext capabilities. Well-structured with clear examples. Slightly less detail on long-running tools and confirmation flow.

models.md.notes: Strong documentation of BaseLlm interface, Gemini implementation, and LLMRegistry pattern. Clear explanation of API key vs Vertex AI modes. Good coverage of custom LLM registration. Minor gaps in streaming behavior details.

sessions.md.notes: Excellent documentation of Session interface, State class with delta tracking, and the three state prefixes (app:, user:, temp:). Clear explanation of BaseSessionService methods and InMemorySessionService implementation. Well-organized and comprehensive.

events.md.notes: Good coverage of Event interface, EventActions, utility functions, and branching mechanism. Clear explanation of partial events and snake_case/camelCase transformations. Could benefit from more examples of event flow in complex scenarios.

runner.md.notes: Comprehensive documentation of Runner lifecycle, session resumption logic, and RunConfig options. Good coverage of InMemoryRunner, SSE streaming, and InvocationCostManager. Clear explanation of plugin callback execution flow.

plugins.md.notes: Thorough coverage of all 14 BasePlugin lifecycle hooks, PluginManager early-exit strategy, and SecurityPlugin policy enforcement. Good explanation of plugin vs agent callback execution order. Well-structured with practical examples.

auth.md.notes: Good coverage of all AuthCredentialTypes (API_KEY, HTTP, OAUTH2, OPEN_ID_CONNECT, SERVICE_ACCOUNT), OAuth2 flow, and credential exchange system. Clear documentation of ToolContext.requestCredential and AuthHandler. Could benefit from more complete OAuth2 examples.

artifacts.md.notes: Excellent documentation of BaseArtifactService interface, versioning system (incremental version numbers), and GcsArtifactService implementation. Clear explanation of artifact-code execution integration and ForwardingArtifactService pattern.

memory.md.notes: Good coverage of BaseMemoryService interface, MemoryEntry structure, and InMemoryMemoryService. Clear explanation of ToolContext.searchMemory. Well-structured but could benefit from more examples of custom memory service implementations with vector databases.

code-execution.md.notes: Comprehensive documentation of BaseCodeExecutor, BuiltInCodeExecutor, request/response processors, and CodeExecutorContext. Good coverage of stateful execution and error retry logic. Clear explanation of code extraction and artifact integration.

telemetry.md.notes: Excellent documentation of OpenTelemetry integration, tracer setup, span attributes for agent/LLM/tool calls, and GCP exporters. Clear explanation of ADK_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT_IN_SPANS control and runAsyncGeneratorWithOtelContext. Well-organized with complete examples.

cli.md.notes: Good coverage of all CLI commands (web, api_server, create, run, deploy cloud_run) with detailed options. Clear documentation of AgentLoader, file loading system, and compile/bundle pipeline. Could benefit from more complete deployment examples.
